policy: Web runtime HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities are never allowlisted. Development-only exceptions must resolve to an exact advisory, be absent from the production dependency tree, and expire for mandatory review.

exceptions.reason: Transitive dependency of the Next.js ESLint toolchain. The production dependency audit must remain clean and the package must be absent from the production tree.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove immediately when the dependency tree no longer reports the advisory or an upstream patched release can be adopted without reducing security.
